title: Datadog is now available on Anthropic’s Claude Marketplace
summary: Datadog is available on Anthropic’s Claude Marketplace, offering you a simpler way to gain visibility into your Claude-powered AI applications.
body_markdown:
Marlisa Gashaj


Senior Technology Partner Manager


Richard Liu


Product Manager


James Harper


Senior Group Manager, Product Marketing


Teams building on Claude are shipping AI agents and applications faster than many organizations can establish standard practices for monitoring them. As these agents move into production, teams need visibility into their costs, reliability, and output quality.


Datadog is available on[Anthropic’s Claude Marketplace](https://claude.com/marketplace/agents-products) , giving joint customers a direct path to bring Datadog’s monitoring capabilities into their AI stack alongside Claude.


## What’s available


At launch, Claude Marketplace offers[Datadog Agent Observability](https://www.datadoghq.com/products/ai/agent-observability/) . With Agent Observability, you can monitor, trace, and evaluate the agents and AI applications your teams build on Claude, so failures and quality regressions surface before they reach end users.


## Built on an existing relationship


Joint customers already use Datadog to monitor their Claude usage by tracing Claude API requests,[bringing Anthropic cost data into Cloud Cost Management](https://www.datadoghq.com/blog/anthropic-usage-and-costs/) , sending Claude Code telemetry, and more. The marketplace listing is the next step: extending that relationship from “Datadog monitors your Claude usage” to “you can buy Datadog directly through Claude.”


## How it works


Claude and Datadog are built to work well together: Claude powers the agents your teams build, and Datadog gives you the visibility to run them confidently and reliably. The marketplace listing doesn’t change how either product works, and it doesn’t require any new technical integration. It just makes that combination easier to put to use.


Here’s how to purchase Datadog Agent Observability through Claude Marketplace:


1.


Fill out the[sales form](https://claude.com/marketplace-contact-sales) that is available on the Datadog tile within Claude Marketplace, or talk to your Anthropic account team about adding Agent Observability.


2.


Apply a portion of your committed Anthropic spend toward your purchase. No new budget line is required.


Your contract and product relationship stay directly with Datadog; the marketplace just simplifies discovery and invoicing. If you already buy Datadog directly, that relationship and process are unaffected by Datadog’s availability on the marketplace.


## Who it’s for


Datadog’s listing on Claude Marketplace is available to customers with US-based entities today, with plans to expand availability over time.


## Get started with Datadog


If you’re already a Claude customer, talk to your Anthropic account team about adding Agent Observability to your plan. If you’re a Datadog customer and have questions about Claude Marketplace, reach out to your Datadog account team.


If you’re new to Datadog, you cansign up for a 14-day free trial .
